fields.description: The mailbox address, e.g. alice@acme.com. Its domain must be a Mail Domain of the tenant. Cannot change after saving.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: Mail Domain the address belongs to. Derived from the email.
fields.label: Domain

fields.description: Suite Tenant that owns the account. Derived from the domain; the tenant's account limit applies.
fields.label: Tenant

fields.description: Cluster the mailbox lives on. Derived from the tenant.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Untick to lock the account: it keeps receiving mail but can no longer log in, send or read. Tick again to restore it.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Tick for a send-only account: it logs in, reads and sends as usual, but mail addressed to it bounces back to the sender. Untick to let it receive again.
fields.label: Disable Receiving

fields.description: Name shown to other users, e.g. Alice Doe. This is the only text sent to the cluster for the account.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: Internal note for operators, e.g. the team or purpose. Stays in Suite Cloud; the cluster never sees it.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Id of the account on the cluster. Set when it is created there.
fields.label: Stalwart ID

fields.description: Login password. Leave blank when creating to have one generated. Type a new one and save to reset it. It is pushed to the cluster and never stored here.
fields.label: Password

fields.description: The account's app passwords on the cluster, refreshed when the form opens. A new row is created on save and its secret shown once; a removed row is revoked. Suite Cloud is the tenant's own login and stays first. The maxAppPasswords quota caps the rows.
fields.label: App Passwords

fields.description: Bearer tokens for the account's JMAP access, handled like the app passwords. Suite Cloud is reserved for Rotate API Key. The maxApiKeys quota caps the rows.
fields.label: API Keys

fields.description: Language tag for server-generated messages and folder names, e.g. en-US or de-DE.
fields.label: Locale

fields.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Blank uses the server's.
fields.label: Time Zone

fields.description: Mailbox size read from the cluster when the account is opened; nothing is stored.
fields.label: Used Disk (bytes)

fields.description: Suite Cloud's own limit on outgoing mail, which Stalwart's storage quotas below do not cover. Counted by the Agents on the cluster's nodes and applied within about 30 seconds of saving.
fields.label: Sending Limits

fields.description: Recipients the account may send to per UTC day. A message to 50 recipients counts as 50. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Daily Send Limit

fields.description: Recipients the account may send to per UTC month. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Monthly Send Limit

fields.description: Stalwart's per-account limits: maxDiskQuota in bytes, the others as counts. Every row is optional; leave one out for no limit.
fields.label: Quotas

fields.description: Other addresses delivered to this mailbox. Each must be unique across the cluster and under one of the tenant's domains.
fields.label: Aliases

fields.description: Mail Groups this account is a member of. Mail sent to a group reaches every member.
fields.label: Groups
